title: Reverse in place
prompt: Implement `static void ReverseInPlace(int[] values)` — reverse the array **without allocating a new one** (two indices walking inward and swapping). Null must be tolerated silently.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: The middle element of an odd-length array stays put.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: One-element and null inputs must not crash — the swap loop simply never runs.
